summary: HSBC Holdings filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign issuer current report) announcing daily purchases under its buy-back programme launched 28 October 2026, executed by Goldman Sachs International. On 2 November 2026 it bought 170,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$12.7107 (range US$12.5660–12.8820) and 600,000 shares in Hong Kong at HK$133.2389 (range HK$131.20–135.00). Cumulative repurchases total 2,307,600 shares for roughly US$39.7m; shares are cancelled, leaving 17,134,513,491 shares outstanding with none in treasury. Watch execution pace versus programme size and HK cancellation lag.
